# Well poisoning

Used in [Water](/rules/logistics/30-water).

## Table

| Attempt | CP | Success on | Retry same stage |
|---|---|---|---|
| poison | 1 | 1 | no |
| sweeten | 5 | 1–3 | yes |

## Notes

- Die results for poisoning and sweetening a village or bir well. The chart prints only the die bands; the CP costs and the retry limits come from 52.16 (1 CP; a failed attempt closes that well to further attempts for the Operations Stage) and 52.17 (5 CP; repeated attempts allowed, capped by the unit's CPA).
- Per rulings/R-021.md, only one unit per well per Operations Stage may attempt sweetening; its CPA caps the repeated attempts.
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 99) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p5): 0 of 4 result bands differ. No errata item touches 52.8.
